claim: Prepares (|100> + |011>)/sqrt(2) by applying Hadamard to q[2] to create the superposition, then X gates to q[1] and q[0] to set the second state.
Encodes integer 11 (binary 1011 with q[0] as LSB) by applying X gates to q[0], q[1], and q[3] to set bits to 1.
Implements 3-bit increment |x> → |x+1 mod 8> using Toffoli and CNOT gates to implement ripple-carry logic: q[2] flips if both q[0] and q[1] are 1, q[1] flips if q[0] is 1, and q[0] always flips.
Implements the specified unitary matrix using a single CNOT gate with q[0] as control and q[1] as target.
Implements inverse QFT on 3 qubits using SWAPs and controlled-phase gates with negated angles to reverse the Fourier transform.
Implements 4-qubit QFT by applying H gates and controlled-phase gates with decreasing angles in a column-by-column pattern, followed by bit reversal SWAPs.
Prepares the state resulting from applying QFT(3) to |110> by first initializing the basis state then applying the standard QFT circuit.
Applies controlled-RZ(π/2) with q[1] as control qubit and q[0] as target qubit using Qiskit's CRZ gate.
Decomposes CP(π/4) using two CX gates and RZ rotations to apply phase rotation to the |11> state.
Implements SX gate as a sandwich of H gates around a π/2 phase gate.
